meaning: E0b-initialized RGB photometric gradient ray-depth optimization
renderer: unchanged P2 Gaussian sigma=.65px radius=2px front gate=.03
active_set: at least two distinct original cameras; nonzero parallax; visible in all original source cameras under the E2/E3 initial visibility policy
point_rgb: per-channel median of original observation RGB in each E0b CSR group; fixed during optimization; not the diagnostic palette
train_mask: initial E0b alpha>=.5 intersect E1 F0 fixed mask; frozen
selection: minimum training Charbonnier among steps 0/20/.../200; no GT
gt_scale: fit one median GT/initial E0b native front-Z scale after training; keep fixed for selected and last
gt_mask: initial E0b valid native front Z and valid GT; common intersection of initial/selected/last plus fixed-mask coverage
